sources.excerpt: Indonesia is strengthening the protection of marine resources in the North Natuna Sea by building 10 new patrol vessels and expanding the pier at the Batam Marine and Fisheries Resources Surveillance (PSDKP) Base.

summary: In September 2026 Indonesia awarded the contract for the Natuna D-Alpha exploration block, northeast of the Natuna Islands within China's nine-dash line and the site of the 2024 CCG-Bakamla standoff, to PT Nations, a subsidiary of the Arsari Group headed by President Prabowo's brother Hashim Djojohadikusumo.
